title: Effects of one night of sleep deprivation on single- and dual-task gait

abstract_extraction.primary_outcome: gait changes (spatio-temporal parameters, foot placement error, and mediolateral margin of stability)
abstract_extraction.direction_summary: Declined: sleep deprivation altered gait parameters and decreased mediolateral margin of stability, indicating impaired walking stability/control.
abstract_extraction.evidence: Additionally, mean MoS ML decreased only in SDEP ( p = 0.025).

body_extraction.primary_outcome: biomechanical gait parameters (spatio-temporal parameters, foot placement control, and mediolateral margins of stability)
body_extraction.direction_summary: Mixed gait changes following sleep deprivation: step time and step length increased, mediolateral stability decreased, and foot placement error AP decreased, while other parameters showed no effect.
body_extraction.evidence: SDEP and DT uniquely affected ML and AP foot placement control... SDEP led to a decrease in mean MoS ML

paper_type.detail: abstract says empirical, body says empirical

sample_size_consistency.detail: abstract N [18] | methods/results enrolled 22, analyzed 18 (attrition between enrolled and analyzed)
